name: There's Someone in the Corner of My Room
source:
You wake up to find a man standing in the corner of your room, and he seems to get closer every night.

[From [url=https://marrowed-yuu.itch.io/theres-someone-in-the-corner-of-my-room]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你醒来发现一个男人站在你房间的角落里，而且他似乎每晚都离你更近。

[来自[url=https://marrowed-yuu.itch.io/theres-someone-in-the-corner-of-my-room]Itch.io[/url]]
